verdict.rationale: Quo is a business communications SaaS, so shipping an official CLI is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, API keys, an MCP server and one-click AI connectors, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. The API and MCP server are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit for a CLI story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
